definitions.gloss: policy shift; change of direction; reversal of course
definitions.explanation: A deliberate change in an established policy, strategy, or approach. Used in politics, business, and personal decisions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{方針転換|ほうしんてんかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: The government announced a policy shift.

examples.japanese: {売|う}り{上|あ}げ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{低迷|ていめい}→低迷：09332_teimei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けて→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧⟦{方針|ほうしん}→方針：04871_houshin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{転換|てんかん}→転換：19439_tenkan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{図|はか}った→図る：12006_hakaru⟧。
examples.english: Facing sluggish sales, they attempted a change in business strategy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧な{方針転換|ほうしんてんかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{混乱|こんらん}→混乱：02811_konran⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The sudden policy reversal caused confusion on the ground.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{方針|ほうしん}→方針：04871_houshin⟧ (policy, course of action) and ⟦{転換|てんかん}→転換：19439_tenkan⟧ (conversion, switch). Very common in news reporting about political and corporate decisions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {方針転換|ほうしんてんかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{図|はか}る→図る：12006_hakaru⟧ — to attempt a policy shift
- {方針転換|ほうしんてんかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迫|せま}られる→迫る：03928_semaru⟧ — to be forced into a policy change
- ⟦{大幅|おおはば}→大幅：12170_oohaba⟧な{方針転換|ほうしんてんかん} — a major policy shift
- ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧な{方針転換|ほうしんてんかん} — a sudden change of course

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{路線変更|ろせんへんこう}→路線変更：26434_rosenhenkou⟧: change of policy/route — similar meaning, slightly more informal
- {軌道修正|きどうしゅうせい}: course correction — implies a smaller adjustment rather than a full reversal
- ⟦{転換|てんかん}→転換：19439_tenkan⟧: conversion, shift — the broader term without specifying it is about policy
